translations.literal: If one goes north from Yangcheng to the land of Tiele, likewise differing seventeen and four-tenths degrees — equal to Linyi — then in the fifth month the sun stands twenty-seven and four-tenths degrees south of the zenith; the pole stands fifty-two degrees high; the circumpolar circuit one hundred four degrees — constantly visible, never hidden.
translations.idiomatic: If one travels north from Yangcheng to the land of the Tiele, a difference of seventeen and four-tenths degrees — equal to Linyi — then in the fifth month the sun stands twenty-seven and four-tenths degrees south of the zenith; the pole, fifty-two degrees high. Stars within one hundred four degrees of the pole would be constantly visible and never set.

sentences.zh: 北至晷四尺一寸三分，南至晷二丈九尺二寸六分，定春秋分晷五尺八寸七分。

translations.literal: Northward gnomon shadow four chi, one cun, and three fen; southward gnomon shadow two zhang, nine chi, two cun, and six fen; fixed spring and autumn equinox gnomon shadow five chi, eight cun, and seven fen.
translations.idiomatic: The northern shadow would measure four chi, one cun, and three fen; the southern shadow, two zhang, nine chi, two cun, and six fen; the fixed equinox shadow, five chi, eight cun, and seven fen.

sentences.zh: 其沒地才十五餘度，夕沒亥西，晨出丑東，校其里數，已在回紇之北，又南距洛陽九千八百一十五里，則極長之晝，其夕常明。

translations.literal: Stars set barely fifteen-odd degrees below the earth; at evening they set west of hai, at morning they rise east of chou. Checking the distance in li, it already lies north of the Uighur, and south of Luoyang by nine thousand eight hundred fifteen li — then in the longest days, the evening is constantly bright.
translations.idiomatic: Stars would set barely fifteen-odd degrees below the horizon; at evening they would set west of hai, at morning rise east of chou. By the reckoned distance, this point lies north of the Uighur and nine thousand eight hundred fifteen li south of Luoyang — where in the longest days, twilight never fully fades.

sentences.zh: 然則骨利幹猶在其南矣。

translations.literal: Then Guligan would still lie south of it.
translations.idiomatic: Guligan, then, would lie even farther north.

sentences.zh: 吳中常侍王蕃考先儒所傳，以戴日下萬五千里為句股，斜射陽城，考周徑之率以揆天度，當千四百六里二十四步有餘。

translations.literal: Wang Fan, Attendant-in-Ordinary of Wu, examined what the earlier scholars transmitted: taking fifteen thousand li under the sun's bearing as the right triangle's legs, obliquely projecting toward Yangcheng, and checking the ratio of circumference to diameter to measure heavenly degrees, it should be one thousand four hundred six li and twenty-four-odd paces.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fan, Attendant-in-Ordinary of Wu, reviewed the earlier scholars' transmission: using fifteen thousand li under the sun's bearing as a right triangle and projecting obliquely toward Yangcheng, he calculated the ratio of circumference to diameter and derived a degree-span of one thousand four hundred six li and twenty-four-odd paces.

sentences.zh: 今測日晷，距陽城五千里，已在戴日之南，則一度之廣皆三分減二，南北極相去八萬里，其徑五萬里。

translations.literal: Now measuring the sun's gnomon shadow, five thousand li from Yangcheng already lies south of the sun's bearing — then the breadth of each degree is reduced by two-thirds throughout; the distance between north and south poles is eighty thousand li, and the diameter fifty thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: The new gnomon measurements show that five thousand li from Yangcheng already lies south of the sun's bearing — reducing the span of each degree by two-thirds. The distance between the north and south poles is eighty thousand li, and the diameter fifty thousand li.

sentences.zh: 宇宙之廣，豈若是乎？

translations.literal: Can the breadth of the cosmos really be so small?
translations.idiomatic: Can the cosmos really be so small?

sentences.zh: 然則蕃之術，以蠡測海者也。

translations.literal: Then Fan's method is like measuring the sea with a gourd dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Fan's method, then, is like measuring the sea with a gourd dipper.

sentences.zh: 古人所以恃句股術，謂其有證於近事。

translations.literal: The ancients relied on the gougu method because they held that it had proof in nearby matters.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients trusted the gougu method because they believed it could be verified by nearby observations.

sentences.zh: 顧未知目視不能及遠，遠則微差，其差不已，遂與術錯。

translations.literal: But they did not know that the eye cannot reach far; at distance there are slight discrepancies, and as these accumulate without cease, the reckoning itself goes astray.
translations.idiomatic: They did not recognize that sight cannot penetrate great distances; over distance, minute discrepancies accumulate without cease until the reckoning itself goes astray.

sentences.zh: 譬游於太湖，廣袤不盈百里，見日月朝夕出入湖中；

translations.literal: It is like boating on Lake Tai — its breadth and length do not exceed a hundred li, and one sees the sun and moon rise and set in the lake morning and evening;
translations.idiomatic: Consider boating on Lake Tai, whose expanse does not exceed a hundred li in any direction: morning and evening one sees the sun and moon rise and set from within the lake itself;

sentences.zh: 及其浮於巨海，不知幾千萬里，猶見日月朝夕出入其中矣。

translations.literal: Yet when one floats on the great sea, unknowable thousands of myriads of li, one still sees the sun and moon rise and set within it morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when one sails the great ocean, whose span runs to countless thousands of myriads of li, one still sees the sun and moon rise and set within its waters morning and evening.

sentences.zh: 若於朝夕之際，俱設重差而望之，必將大小之同術，無以分矣。

translations.literal: If at dawn and dusk one set up double-difference sighting for both alike, the same method for large and small would yield no distinction.
translations.idiomatic: If at dawn and dusk one applied the double-difference method to both alike, the same technique for the small and the vast would yield no distinction between them.

sentences.zh: 橫既有之，縱亦宜然。

translations.literal: If this holds horizontally, vertically it should be the same.
translations.idiomatic: If this holds in the horizontal dimension, it ought to hold vertically as well.

sentences.zh: 又若樹兩表，南北相距十里，其崇皆數十里，置大炬于南表之端，而植八尺之木於其下，則當無影。

translations.literal: Suppose two gnomons are erected ten li apart north and south, each tens of li in height; if a great torch is placed at the top of the southern gnomon and an eight-chi stake planted beneath it, there should be no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose two gnomons stand ten li apart on a north-south line, each tens of li high: place a great torch at the top of the southern gnomon and an eight-chi stake beneath it — the shadow ought to vanish entirely.

sentences.zh: 試從南表之下，仰望北表之端，必將積微分之差，漸與南表參合。

translations.literal: Looking from below the southern gnomon up to the top of the northern gnomon, minute fractional differences would gradually align with the southern gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: Look up from the foot of the southern gnomon toward the crown of the northern one, and minute fractional errors will gradually merge until the northern gnomon aligns with the southern.

sentences.zh: 表首參合，則置炬於其上，亦當無影矣。

translations.literal: When the tops align, placing a torch there should also cast no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Once the tops coincide, a torch placed there should likewise cast no shadow.

sentences.zh: 又置大炬於北表之端，而植八尺之木於其下，則當無影。

translations.literal: Again place a great torch at the top of the northern gnomon and plant an eight-chi stake beneath it — there should be no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Place a great torch at the top of the northern gnomon and an eight-chi stake beneath it — again, the shadow ought to vanish.

sentences.zh: 試從北表之下，仰望南表之端，又將積微分之差，漸與北表參合。

translations.literal: Looking from below the northern gnomon up to the top of the southern gnomon, minute fractional differences would again gradually align with the northern gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: Look up from the foot of the northern gnomon toward the crown of the southern one, and minute fractional errors will again gradually merge until the southern gnomon aligns with the northern.

sentences.zh: 表首參合，則置炬於其上，亦當無影矣。

translations.literal: When the tops align, placing a torch there should also cast no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Once the tops coincide, a torch placed there should likewise cast no shadow.

sentences.zh: 復於二表間更植八尺之木，仰而望之，則表首環屈相合。

translations.literal: Again plant an eight-chi stake between the two gnomons and look up — the gnomon tops would curve and bend to meet.
translations.idiomatic: Plant another eight-chi stake midway between the two gnomons and gaze upward — the gnomon tops will appear to bow and meet in a curve.

sentences.zh: 若置火炬於兩表之端，皆當無影矣。

translations.literal: If torches were placed atop both gnomons, both ought to cast no shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Place torches atop both gnomons, and each should cast no shadow.

sentences.zh: 夫數十里之高與十里之廣，然猶斜射之影與仰望不殊。

translations.literal: For heights of tens of li and breadth of ten li, obliquely cast shadows and upward gazing would still be indistinguishable.
translations.idiomatic: At heights of tens of li and spans of ten li, oblique shadows and lines of sight still appear indistinguishable.

sentences.zh: 今欲憑晷差以指遠近高下，尚不可知，而況稽周天裏步於不測之中，又可必乎？

translations.literal: Now if one wishes to determine distance and height by gnomon-shadow difference and still cannot know, how much less can one definitively reckon the circuit of heaven in li within the immeasurable?
translations.idiomatic: If gnomon-shadow differences cannot even reliably gauge nearby height and distance, how can one presume to reckon the circuit of heaven in li within the immeasurable depths of space?

sentences.zh: 十三年，南至，岱宗禮畢，自上傳呼萬歲，聲聞於下。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, at the solstice rites, after completing ceremonies at Daizong, from above they called "Ten thousand years!" and the sound was heard below.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, after the solstice rites at Mount Tai were complete, voices cried "Ten thousand years!" from the summit — audible all the way below.

sentences.zh: 時山下夜漏未盡，自日觀東望，日已漸高。

translations.literal: At that time at the mountain foot the night clepsydra had not yet run out; gazing east from Sun-Viewing Peak, the sun was already climbing high.
translations.idiomatic: At the mountain's foot the night water-clock had not yet emptied, yet gazing east from Sun-Viewing Peak, the sun had already climbed high.

sentences.zh: 據曆法，晨初迨日出差二刻半，然則山上所差凡三刻餘。

translations.literal: According to calendrical reckoning, from first light until sunrise differs by two and a half ke; thus the difference on the mountain amounted to slightly more than three ke.
translations.idiomatic: By calendrical reckoning, first light precedes sunrise by two and a half ke; on the summit the total difference came to slightly more than three ke.

sentences.zh: 其冬至夜刻同立春之後，春分夜刻同立夏之後。

translations.literal: The winter solstice night's ke equal those after Beginning of Spring; the spring equinox night's ke equal those after Beginning of Summer.
translations.idiomatic: The night watches at the winter solstice correspond to those after Beginning of Spring; those at the spring equinox correspond to those after Beginning of Summer.

sentences.zh: 自嶽趾升泰壇僅二十里，而晝夜之差一節。

translations.literal: From the mountain's foot ascending the Tai altar is barely twenty li, yet the difference between day and night spans one seasonal node.
translations.idiomatic: From the mountain's base to the altar at the summit is barely twenty li — yet the day-night difference spans a full seasonal node.

sentences.zh: 設使因二十里之崇以立句股術，固不知其所以然，況八尺之表乎！

translations.literal: Even if one established the gougu method from twenty li of height, one would not know the reason why; how much less with an eight-chi gnomon!
translations.idiomatic: Even building the gougu method on twenty li of elevation, one could not grasp the underlying cause — to say nothing of an eight-chi gnomon!

sentences.zh: 原古人所以步圭影之意，將以節宣和氣，轉相物宜，不在於辰次之周徑。

translations.literal: Consider the ancients' intent in measuring the earth-square shadow: to regulate and harmonize the qi, in turn matching things to their appropriate conditions — not to determine the circuit and diameter of the celestial lodges.
translations.idiomatic: Consider why the ancients measured the earth-square shadows: to harmonize the seasons and match each thing to its proper time — not to calculate the circumference and diameter of the celestial lodges.

sentences.zh: 其所以重歷數之意，將欲恭授人時，欽若乾象，不在於渾、蓋之是非。

translations.literal: Their intent in emphasizing calendrical reckoning was to reverently grant the seasons to the people and honor the heavenly pattern — not to judge between armillary and canopy models.
translations.idiomatic: Their purpose in honoring calendrical reckoning was to reverently grant the seasons to the people and conform to the celestial pattern — not to settle the dispute between armillary and canopy heaven.

sentences.zh: 若乃述無稽之法於視聽之所不及，則君子當闕疑而不議也。

translations.literal: If one expounds groundless methods beyond the reach of sight and hearing, the gentleman should leave them in doubt and not debate them.
translations.idiomatic: To expound unverifiable methods beyond the reach of sight and sound — here a gentleman should preserve his doubts and refrain from debate.

sentences.zh: 而或者各守所傳之器以術天體，謂渾元可任數而測，大象可運算而窺。

translations.literal: Yet some cling to their inherited instruments to reckon the celestial body, saying the armillary origin can be measured by calculation and the great pattern contemplated through computation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet some cling to inherited instruments to fathom the heavens, claiming the armillary origin can be measured by number and the great pattern glimpsed through calculation.

sentences.zh: 終以六家之說，迭為矛盾，誠以為蓋天邪？

translations.literal: In the end the six schools' doctrines contradict one another in turn — if one truly holds it is canopy heaven?
translations.idiomatic: The six schools' doctrines end in perpetual contradiction. If one truly holds to canopy heaven?

sentences.zh: 則南方之度漸狹；

translations.literal: Then the southern degrees gradually narrow;
translations.idiomatic: Then the degrees in the south ought to grow progressively narrower;

sentences.zh: 果以為渾天邪？

translations.literal: If one truly holds it is armillary heaven?
translations.idiomatic: If one truly holds to armillary heaven?

sentences.zh: 則北方之極浸高。

translations.literal: Then the northern pole gradually rises higher.
translations.idiomatic: Then the northern pole ought to climb progressively higher.

sentences.zh: 此二者，又渾、蓋之家盡智畢議，未能有以通其說也。

translations.literal: On these two points, even the armillary and canopy schools exhausting all wisdom and debate could not reconcile their doctrines.
translations.idiomatic: On these two points even the armillary and canopy schools, exhausting all wisdom and debate, could find no way to reconcile their doctrines.

sentences.zh: 則王仲任、葛稚川之徒，區區于異同之辨，何益人倫之化哉。

translations.literal: As for Wang Zhongren, Ge Zhichuan, and their sort, fussing over differences and sameness — what benefit to the transformation of human relations?
translations.idiomatic: As for Wang Chong, Ge Hong, and their ilk, what profit to the moral transformation of humanity in their petty disputations over doctrine?

sentences.zh: 凡晷差，冬夏不同，南北亦異，先儒一以里數齊之，遂失其實。

translations.literal: In all gnomon-shadow differences, winter and summer differ and north and south differ as well; earlier scholars uniformized them by li-count and thus lost the truth.
translations.idiomatic: Gnomon-shadow differences vary between winter and summer and between north and south; earlier scholars forced them into a single li-count ratio and thereby lost the truth.

sentences.zh: 今更為《覆矩圖》，南自丹穴，北暨幽都，每極移一度，輒累其差，可以稽日食之多少，定晝夜之長短，而天下之晷，皆協其數矣。

translations.literal: Now a new Inverted Square Diagram has been made, from Dannue in the south to Youdu in the north; for each degree the pole shifts, the difference is accumulated, by which one may check the extent of solar eclipses and fix day and night length — and gnomons throughout the realm will all accord with the numbers.
translations.idiomatic: A new Inverted Square Diagram has now been drawn, from Dannue in the south to Youdu in the north: for each degree the pole shifts, the difference is accumulated, enabling one to reckon the magnitude of eclipses and fix the length of day and night — so that gnomon shadows throughout the realm accord with a single standard.

sentences.zh: 昭宗時，太子少詹事邊岡，脩曆術，服其精粹，以為不刊之數也。

translations.literal: In the Zhaozong era, Vice-Director of the Crown Prince's Household Bian Gang revised the calendrical methods and accepted their refinement, holding them to be immutable numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhaozong era, Vice-Director of the Crown Prince's Household Bian Gang revised the calendrical methods, admired their refinement, and declared them an immutable standard.

sentences.zh: 初，貞觀中，淳風撰《法象志》，因《漢書》十二次度數，始以唐之州縣配焉。

translations.literal: At first, during Zhenguan, Chunfeng compiled the Astronomical Phenomena Treatise, following the twelve lunar-lodge degree counts in the Book of Han, and for the first time paired them with Tang prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhenguan reign, Li Chunfeng compiled the Astronomical Phenomena Treatise, following the twelve lunar-lodge degree counts in the Book of Han and for the first time matching them to Tang prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 而一行以為天下山河之象存乎兩戒。

translations.literal: But Yixing held that the pattern of mountains and rivers throughout the realm resided in the Two Prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing, however, held that the pattern of mountains and rivers throughout the realm resided in the Two Prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 北戒自三危、積石，負終南地絡之陰，東及太華，逾河，並雷首、厎柱、王屋、太行，北抵常山之右，乃東循塞坦，至濊貊、朝鮮，是謂北紀，所以限戎狄也；

translations.literal: The Northern Prohibition begins at Sanwei and Jishi, bearing the yin of the Zhongnan terrestrial vein, extends east to Mount Taihua, crosses the river, joins Leishou, Dizhu, Wangwu, and Taihang, north to the right of Mount Chang, then east along the border ramparts to Huimo and Korea — this is called the Northern Thread, which bounds the Rong and Di;
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Prohibition begins at Sanwei and Jishi, bearing the yin side of the Zhongnan terrestrial vein, extends east to Mount Taihua, crosses the Yellow River, joins Leishou, Dizhu, Wangwu, and Taihang, reaches the right flank of Mount Chang, then runs east along the border ramparts to Huimo and Korea — this is called the Northern Thread, which bounds the Rong and Di;

sentences.zh: 南戒自岷山、嶓塚，負地絡之陽，東及太華，連益山、熊耳、外方、桐柏，自上洛南逾江、漢，攜武當、荊山，至於衡陽，乃東循嶺徼，達東甌、閩中，是謂南紀，所以限蠻夷也。

translations.literal: The Southern Prohibition begins at Mount Min and Mount Bo, bearing the yang of the terrestrial vein, east to Mount Taihua, connecting Mount Yi, Mount Xiong'er, Mount Waifang, and Mount Tongbai, from Shangluo south crossing the Yangtze and Han, embracing Wudang and Mount Jing, reaching Hengyang, then east along the ridge borders to Dong'ou and Minzhong — this is called the Southern Thread, which bounds the Man and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Prohibition begins at Mount Min and Mount Bo, bearing the yang side of the terrestrial vein, extends east to Mount Taihua, connects Mount Yi, Mount Xiong'er, Mount Waifang, and Mount Tongbai, from Shangluo south crosses the Yangtze and Han, embraces Wudang and Mount Jing, reaches Hengyang, then runs east along the ridge borders to Dong'ou and Minzhong — this is called the Southern Thread, which bounds the Man and Yi.

sentences.zh: 故《星傳》謂北戒為「胡門」，南戒為「越門」。

translations.literal: Hence the Star Tradition calls the Northern Prohibition the "Barbarian Gate" and the Southern Prohibition the "Yue Gate."
translations.idiomatic: The Star Tradition therefore calls the Northern Prohibition the "Barbarian Gate" and the Southern Prohibition the "Yue Gate."

sentences.zh: 河源自北紀之首，循雍州北徼，達華陰，而與地絡相會，並行而東，至太行之曲，分而東流，與涇、謂、濟瀆相為表裏，謂之「北河」。

translations.literal: The Yellow River's source is at the head of the Northern Thread, following Yongzhou's northern border to Huayin, meeting the terrestrial vein, running parallel east to the bend of Taihang, dividing and flowing east, inner and outer with the Jing, Wei, and Ji waterways — called the "Northern River."
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River rises at the head of the Northern Thread, follows Yongzhou's northern border to Huayin, meets the terrestrial vein, runs east in parallel to the bend of Taihang, then divides and flows eastward, paired inside and out with the Jing, Wei, and Ji waterways — this is called the "Northern River."

sentences.zh: 江源自南紀之首，循梁州南徼，達華陽，而與地絡相會，並行而東，及荊山之陽，分而東流，與漢水、淮瀆相為表裏，謂之「南河」。

translations.literal: The Yangtze's source is at the head of the Southern Thread, following Liangzhou's southern border to Huayang, meeting the terrestrial vein, running parallel east to the yang side of Mount Jing, dividing and flowing east, inner and outer with the Han River and Huai waterway — called the "Southern River."
translations.idiomatic: The Yangtze rises at the head of the Southern Thread, follows Liangzhou's southern border to Huayang, meets the terrestrial vein, runs east in parallel to the sunny side of Mount Jing, then divides and flows eastward, paired inside and out with the Han River and Huai waterway — this is called the "Southern River."

sentences.zh: 故于天象，則弘農分陝為兩河之會，五服諸侯在焉。

translations.literal: Hence in celestial signs, Hongnong at Fen-Shan is the confluence of the two rivers, where the feudal lords of the five domains dwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the celestial pattern, therefore, Hongnong at the Fen-Shan divide marks the confluence of the two rivers, where the lords of the five domains were seated.

sentences.zh: 自陝而西為秦、涼，北紀山河之曲為晉、代，南紀山河之曲為巴、蜀，皆負險用武之國也。

translations.literal: West of Shaan is Qin and Liang; the bends of the Northern Thread's mountains and rivers are Jin and Dai; the bends of the Southern Thread's mountains and rivers are Ba and Shu — all lands relying on perilous terrain and martial strength.
translations.idiomatic: West of Shaan lay Qin and Liang; the bends of the Northern Thread's mountains and rivers formed Jin and Dai; those of the Southern Thread formed Ba and Shu — all lands that relied on natural defenses and martial force.

sentences.zh: 自陝而東，三川、中嶽為成周；

translations.literal: East of Shaan, the Three Rivers and Central Peak form Chengzhou;
translations.idiomatic: East of Shaan, the Three Rivers and Central Peak formed Chengzhou;

sentences.zh: 西距外方、大伾，北至於濟，南至於淮，東達钜野，為宋、鄭、陳、蔡；

translations.literal: Bounded west by Waifang and Great Pei, north to the Ji River, south to the Huai, east to Juye — Song, Zheng, Chen, and Cai;
translations.idiomatic: bounded on the west by Waifang and Great Pei, north to the Ji River, south to the Huai, east to Juye — the lands of Song, Zheng, Chen, and Cai;

sentences.zh: 河內及濟水之陽為鄁、衛；

translations.literal: Henei and the yang side of the Ji River — Bei and Wei;
translations.idiomatic: Henei and the north bank of the Ji River formed Bei and Wei;

sentences.zh: 漢東濱淮水之陰為申、隨。

translations.literal: East of the Han River along the yin side of the Huai — Shen and Sui.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Han River, along the south bank of the Huai, lay Shen and Sui.

sentences.zh: 皆四戰用文之國也。

translations.literal: All lands of four-sided warfare relying on culture.
translations.idiomatic: All were lands of four-front warfare that relied on culture rather than terrain.

sentences.zh: 北紀之東，至北河之北，為邢、趙。

translations.literal: East of the Northern Thread, north of the Northern River — Xing and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Northern Thread, north of the Northern River, lay Xing and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 南紀之東，至南河之南，為荊、楚。

translations.literal: East of the Southern Thread, south of the Southern River — Jing and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Southern Thread, south of the Southern River, lay Jing and Chu.

sentences.zh: 自北河下流，南距岱山為三齊，夾右碣石為北燕。

translations.literal: From the lower Northern River, south to Mount Dai — the Three Qi; flanking Jieshi to the right — Northern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: From the lower Northern River, south to Mount Dai, lay the Three Qi; flanking Jieshi to the right lay Northern Yan.

sentences.zh: 自南河下流，北距岱山為鄒、魯，南涉江、淮為吳、越。

translations.literal: From the lower Southern River, north to Mount Dai — Zou and Lu; south crossing the Yangtze and Huai — Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: From the lower Southern River, north to Mount Dai lay Zou and Lu; south across the Yangtze and Huai lay Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 皆負海之國，貸殖之所阜也。

translations.literal: All sea-facing lands where trade and prosperity gather.
translations.idiomatic: All were sea-facing lands where trade and prosperity flourished.

sentences.zh: 自河源循塞垣北，東及海，為戎狄。

translations.literal: From the river source following the border ramparts north, east to the sea — the Rong and Di.
translations.idiomatic: From the river source, following the border ramparts north to the sea, lay the Rong and Di.

sentences.zh: 自江源循嶺徼南，東及海，為蠻越。

translations.literal: From the river source following the ridge borders south, east to the sea — the Man and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: From the river source, following the ridge borders south to the sea, lay the Man and Yue.

sentences.zh: 觀兩河之象。

translations.literal: Observing the pattern of the two rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Observe the pattern of the two rivers

sentences.zh: 與雲漢之所始終，而分野可知矣。

translations.literal: Together with where the Cloud River begins and ends, the territorial divisions become knowable.
translations.idiomatic: together with the Cloud River's beginning and end, and the territorial divisions become knowable.

sentences.zh: 于《易》，五月一陰生，而雲漢潛萌於天稷之下，進及井、鉞間，得坤維之氣，陰始達於地上，而雲漢上升，始交於列宿，七緯之氣通矣。

translations.literal: In the Changes, in the fifth month one yin is born; the Cloud River secretly sprouts beneath Tianji, advancing to between Well and Axe, obtaining the qi of the kun axis; yin first reaches the ground, and the Cloud River rises, first crossing the fixed stars — the qi of the seven regulators becomes continuous.
translations.idiomatic: In the Book of Changes, when in the fifth month the first yin is born, the Cloud River secretly germinates beneath Tianji, advancing to between Well and Axe, receiving the qi of the kun axis; as yin first reaches the earth, the Cloud River ascends and first crosses the fixed stars — and the qi of the seven regulators flows through.

sentences.zh: 東井據百川上流，故鶉首為秦、蜀墟，得兩戒山河之首。

translations.literal: Eastern Well occupies the upper reaches of the hundred streams; hence Qu Shou is the domain of Qin and Shu, obtaining the head of the Two Prohibitions' mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Well occupies the upper reaches of the hundred streams; hence Qu Shou marks the domain of Qin and Shu, receiving the headwaters of the Two Prohibitions' mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 雲漢達坤維右而漸升，始居列宿上，觜觿、參、伐皆直天關表而在河陰，故實沈下流得大樑，距河稍遠，涉陰亦深。

translations.literal: The Cloud River reaching right of the kun axis and gradually rising, first occupying above the fixed stars; Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and Orion all directly face outside Heaven's Gate and lie in the yin side of the river; hence Shi Shen's lower reach obtains Great Bridge, somewhat far from the river, also deeper in yin.
translations.idiomatic: The Cloud River reaches right of the kun axis and gradually ascends, first rising above the fixed stars; Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and Orion all stand directly outside Heaven's Gate on the yin side of the river — hence Shi Shen's lower reach obtains Great Bridge, somewhat farther from the river and deeper in yin.

sentences.zh: 故其分野，自漳濱卻負恒山，居北紀眾山之東南，外接髦頭地，皆河外陰國也。

translations.literal: Hence its territorial division: from the Zhang River's shore back bearing Mount Heng, dwelling southeast of the Northern Thread's multitude of mountains, outward connecting the land of Maotou — all yin countries beyond the northern river.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial division therefore runs from the Zhang River's shore back to Mount Heng, southeast of the Northern Thread's mountains, outward connecting the land of Maotou — all yin lands beyond the northern river.

sentences.zh: 十月陰氣進逾乾維，始上達于天，雲漢至營室、東壁間，升氣悉究，與內規相接。

translations.literal: In the tenth month yin qi advances past the qian axis, first reaching up to heaven; the Cloud River arrives between Encampment and Eastern Wall; ascending qi is fully exhausted and connects with the inner rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month yin qi advances past the qian axis and first reaches heaven; the Cloud River arrives between Encampment and Eastern Wall, ascending qi is fully spent, and it connects with the inner rule.

sentences.zh: 故自南正達於西正，得雲漢升氣，為山河上流；

translations.literal: Hence from southern culmination to western culmination, obtaining Cloud River ascending qi — the upper reaches of mountains and rivers;
translations.idiomatic: From southern culmination to western culmination, receiving Cloud River ascending qi — the upper reaches of mountains and rivers;

sentences.zh: 自北正達於東正，得雲漢降氣，為山河下流。

translations.literal: From northern culmination to eastern culmination, obtaining Cloud River descending qi — the lower reaches of mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: From northern culmination to eastern culmination, receiving Cloud River descending qi — the lower reaches of mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 陬訾在雲漢升降中，居水行正位，故其分野當中州河、濟間。

translations.literal: Zouzi is in the middle of the Cloud River's ascent and descent, occupying the orthodox position of the Water phase; hence its division lies between the Yellow and Ji rivers in the central provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Zouzi stands in the middle of the Cloud River's ascent and descent, occupying the orthodox position of the Water phase; hence its division lies between the Yellow and Ji rivers in the central provinces.

sentences.zh: 且王良、閣道由紫垣絕漢抵營室，上帝離宮也，內接成周、河內，皆豕韋分。

translations.literal: Moreover Wangliang and Celestial Ford from the Purple Enclosure cross the Han to reach Encampment — the Supreme Lord's detached palace; inward connecting Chengzhou and Henei — all Shiwei's division.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Wangliang and Celestial Ford run from the Purple Enclosure across the Han to Encampment — the Supreme Lord's detached palace — inward connecting Chengzhou and Henei, all within Shiwei's division.

sentences.zh: 十一月一陽生，而雲漢漸降，退及艮維，始下接於地，至斗、建間，復與列舍氣通，于《易》，天地始交，泰象也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month one yang is born; the Cloud River gradually descends, retreating to the gen axis, first connecting downward to earth; reaching between Dipper and Establishment, again connecting with fixed lodges' qi — in the Changes, heaven and earth first meet — the hexagram Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the first yang is born; the Cloud River gradually descends, retreating to the gen axis and first connecting with the earth; reaching between Dipper and Establishment, it again connects with the qi of the fixed lodges — in the Book of Changes, heaven and earth first meet: the hexagram Tai.

sentences.zh: 逾析木津，陰氣益降，進及大辰，升陽之氣究，而雲漢沈潛於東正之中，故《易》，雷出地曰豫，龍出泉為解，皆房、心象也。

translations.literal: Crossing the Timber-Felling Ford, yin qi further descends, advancing to Great Chen; ascending yang qi is exhausted and the Cloud River sinks hidden within eastern culmination — hence in the Changes, "thunder emerging from earth is called Yu; dragon emerging from spring is called Xie" — all images of Heart and Heart-and-Body stars.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Timber-Felling Ford, yin qi descends further, advancing to Great Chen; ascending yang qi is spent and the Cloud River sinks hidden within eastern culmination — hence in the Book of Changes, "thunder emerging from earth is called Yu; dragon emerging from spring is called Xie" — all images of Heart and Heart-and-Body.

sentences.zh: 星紀得雲漢下流，百川歸焉，析木為雲漢末派，山河極焉。

translations.literal: Xingji obtains the Cloud River's lower stream where hundred streams return; Ximu is the Cloud River's final branch where mountains and rivers reach their limit.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji receives the Cloud River's lower stream, where the hundred streams converge; Ximu is the Cloud River's final branch, where mountains and rivers reach their limit.

sentences.zh: 故其分野，自南河下流，窮南紀之曲，東南負海，為星紀；

translations.literal: Hence its territorial division: from the lower Southern River, to the end of the Southern Thread's bend, southeast facing the sea — Xingji;
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial division therefore runs from the lower Southern River to the end of the Southern Thread's bend, southeast facing the sea — Xingji;

sentences.zh: 自北河末派，窮北紀之曲，東北負海，為析木。

translations.literal: From the Northern River's final branch, to the end of the Northern Thread's bend, northeast facing the sea — Ximu.
translations.idiomatic: From the Northern River's final branch to the end of the Northern Thread's bend, northeast facing the sea — Ximu.

sentences.zh: 負海者，以其雲漢之陰也。

translations.literal: Those facing the sea — because they lie in the yin of the Cloud River.
translations.idiomatic: Sea-facing lands lie in the yin side of the Cloud River.

sentences.zh: 唯陬訾內接紫宮，在王畿河、濟間。

translations.literal: Only Zouzi inward connects to the Purple Palace, between the Yellow and Ji rivers in the royal domain.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zouzi connects inward to the Purple Palace, between the Yellow and Ji rivers within the royal domain.

sentences.zh: 降婁、玄枵與山河首尾相遠，鄰顓頊之墟，故為中州負海之國也。

translations.literal: Jianglou and Xuanxiao are far from the head and tail of mountains and rivers, neighboring Zhuanxu's domain — hence central province sea-facing countries.
translations.idiomatic: Jianglou and Xuanxiao stand far from the head and tail of the mountains and rivers, neighboring Zhuanxu's domain — hence the central provinces' sea-facing lands.

sentences.zh: 其地當南河之北、北河之南，界以岱宗，至於東海。

translations.literal: Their lands lie north of the Southern River and south of the Northern River, bounded by Mount Dai, reaching the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Their lands lie north of the Southern River and south of the Northern River, bounded by Mount Dai as far as the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 自鶉首逾河，戒東曰鶉火，得重離正位，軒轅之祇在焉。

translations.literal: From Qu Shou crossing the river, the prohibition east is called Qu Huo, obtaining double Li's orthodox position — the altar of Xuanyuan is there.
translations.idiomatic: East of Qu Shou, crossing the river, the eastern prohibition is called Qu Huo, occupying the orthodox position of double Li — the altar of Xuanyuan stands there.

sentences.zh: 其分野，自河、華之交，東接祝融之墟，北負河，南及漢，蓋寒燠之所均也。

translations.literal: Its division: from the junction of the Yellow River and Mount Hua, east connecting Zhurong's domain, north bearing the river, south reaching the Han — where cold and heat are balanced.
translations.idiomatic: Its division runs from the junction of the Yellow River and Mount Hua, east connecting Zhurong's domain, north to the river, south to the Han — a region where cold and heat are evenly balanced.

sentences.zh: 自析木紀天漢而南，曰大火，得明堂升氣，天市之都在焉。

translations.literal: From Ximu marking the Celestial Han southward is called Great Fire, obtaining Bright Hall ascending qi — the capital of Celestial Market is there.
translations.idiomatic: South from Ximu, where it marks the Celestial Han, lies Great Fire, receiving Bright Hall ascending qi — the capital of Celestial Market stands there.

sentences.zh: 其分野，自钜野岱宗，西至陳留，北負河、濟，南及淮，皆和氣之所布也。

translations.literal: Its division: from Juye and Mount Dai, west to Chenliu, north bearing the Yellow and Ji rivers, south to the Huai — all where harmonizing qi is spread.
translations.idiomatic: Its division runs from Juye and Mount Dai west to Chenliu, north to the Yellow and Ji rivers, south to the Huai — all regions where harmonizing qi is spread.

sentences.zh: 陽氣自明堂漸升，達于龍角，曰壽星。

translations.literal: Yang qi gradually rises from Bright Hall, reaching Horn — called Longevity Star.
translations.idiomatic: Yang qi gradually ascends from Bright Hall, reaching Horn — called Longevity Star.

sentences.zh: 龍角謂之天關，于《易》，氣以陽決陰，夬象也。

translations.literal: Horn is called Heaven's Gate; in the Changes, qi uses yang to decide yin — the hexagram Guai.
translations.idiomatic: Horn is called Heaven's Gate; in the Book of Changes, qi uses yang to decide yin — the hexagram Guai.

sentences.zh: 升陽進逾天關。

translations.literal: Ascending yang advances beyond Heaven's Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending yang advances beyond Heaven's Gate.

sentences.zh: 得純乾之位，故鶉尾直建巳之月，內列太微，為天廷。

translations.literal: Obtaining pure Qian's position; hence Chunwei directly corresponds to the month jian-si, inward arrayed with Supreme Subtlety — the celestial court.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the position of pure Qian, Chunwei directly corresponds to the month jian-si, inward arrayed with Supreme Subtlety — the celestial court.

sentences.zh: 其分野，自南河以負海，亦純陽地也。

translations.literal: Its division: from the Southern River sea-facing — also purely yang territory.
translations.idiomatic: Its division runs from the Southern River to the sea — also purely yang territory.

sentences.zh: 壽星在天關內，故其分野，在益、亳西南，淮水之陰，北連太室之東，自陽城際之，亦巽維地也。

translations.literal: Longevity Star is within Heaven's Gate; hence its division is southwest of Yi and Bo, yin side of the Huai River, north connecting east of Mount Taisi, from Yangcheng marking it — also xun axis territory.
translations.idiomatic: Longevity Star lies within Heaven's Gate; hence its division runs southwest of Yi and Bo, on the yin side of the Huai, north connecting east of Mount Taisi, marked from Yangcheng — also xun axis territory.

sentences.zh: 夫雲漢自坤抵艮為地紀，北斗自乾攜巽為天綱，其分野與帝車相直，皆五帝墟也。

translations.literal: The Cloud River from kun to gen is the terrestrial thread; the Big Dipper from qian carrying xun is the celestial net; their territorial divisions align with the Emperor's Carriage — all Five Emperors' domains.
translations.idiomatic: The Cloud River from kun to gen forms the terrestrial thread; the Big Dipper from qian carrying xun forms the celestial net; their territorial divisions align with the Emperor's Carriage — all domains of the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 究咸池之政而在乾維內者，降婁也，故為少昊之墟。

translations.literal: Completing Xianchi's governance and within the qian axis — Jianglou; hence Shaohao's domain.
translations.idiomatic: Completing Xianchi's governance within the qian axis is Jianglou — hence Shaohao's domain.

sentences.zh: 葉北宮之政而在幹維外者，陬訾也，故為顓頊之墟。

translations.literal: Echoing Northern Palace's governance and outside the qian axis — Zouzi; hence Zhuanxu's domain.
translations.idiomatic: Echoing Northern Palace's governance outside the qian axis is Zouzi — hence Zhuanxu's domain.

sentences.zh: 成攝提之政而在巽維內者，壽星也，故為太昊之墟。

translations.literal: Completing Sheti's governance and within the xun axis — Longevity Star; hence Taihao's domain.
translations.idiomatic: Completing Sheti's governance within the xun axis is Longevity Star — hence Taihao's domain.

sentences.zh: 布太微之政，而在巽維外者，鶉尾也，故為列山氏之墟。

translations.literal: Spreading Supreme Subtlety's governance and outside the xun axis — Chunwei; hence Lieshan Clan's domain.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading Supreme Subtlety's governance outside the xun axis is Chunwei — hence the domain of the Lieshan Clan.

sentences.zh: 得四海中承太階之政者，軒轅也，故為有熊氏之墟。

translations.literal: Obtaining within the four seas the governance upholding the Great Steps — Xuanyuan; hence Youxiong Clan's domain.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving within the four seas the governance that upholds the Great Steps is Xuanyuan — hence the domain of the Youxiong Clan.

sentences.zh: 木、金得天地之微氣，其神治于季月；

translations.literal: Wood and Metal obtain heaven-earth's subtle qi; their spirits govern the terminal months;
translations.idiomatic: Wood and Metal receive heaven and earth's subtle qi; their spirits govern the terminal months;

sentences.zh: 水、火得天地之章氣，其神治于孟月。

translations.literal: Water and Fire obtain heaven-earth's manifest qi; their spirits govern the first months.
translations.idiomatic: Water and Fire receive heaven and earth's manifest qi; their spirits govern the first months.

sentences.zh: 故章道存乎至，微道存乎終，皆陰陽變化之際也。

translations.literal: Hence the manifest way resides at the apex; the subtle way resides at the end — all at the junctures of yin-yang transformation.
translations.idiomatic: The manifest way resides at the apex; the subtle way at the end — both at the junctures of yin-yang transformation.

sentences.zh: 若微者沈潛而不及，章者高明而過亢，皆非上帝之居也。

translations.literal: If the subtle sinks hidden without reaching, or the manifest rises bright and overreaches — neither is the Supreme Lord's abode.
translations.idiomatic: If the subtle sinks hidden without attaining, or the manifest rises bright and overreaches — neither is the Supreme Lord's abode.

sentences.zh: 斗杓謂之外廷，陽精之所布也。

translations.literal: The Dipper's Handle is called the Outer Court, where yang essence is spread.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper's Handle is called the Outer Court, where yang essence is spread.

sentences.zh: 斗魁謂之會府，陽精之所復也。

translations.literal: The Dipper's Ladle is called the Assembly Hall, where yang essence returns.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper's Ladle is called the Assembly Hall, where yang essence returns.

sentences.zh: 杓以治外，故鶉尾為南方負海之國。

translations.literal: The Handle governs the outer; hence Chunwei is the southern sea-facing country.
translations.idiomatic: The Handle governs the outer realm; hence Chunwei is the southern sea-facing land.

sentences.zh: 魁以治內，故陬訾為中州四戰之國。

translations.literal: The Ladle governs the inner; hence Zouzi is the central four-front warfare country.
translations.idiomatic: The Ladle governs the inner realm; hence Zouzi is the central land of four-front warfare.

sentences.zh: 其餘列舍，在雲漢之陰者八，為負海之國。

translations.literal: Of the remaining lodges, eight lie on the yin side of the Cloud River and are sea-facing lands.
translations.idiomatic: Of the remaining lodges, eight stand on the northern side of the Cloud River and correspond to sea-facing lands.

sentences.zh: 在雲漢之陽者四，為四戰之國。

translations.literal: Four lie on the yang side of the Cloud River and are lands of four-front warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Four stand on the southern side of the Cloud River and correspond to lands of warfare on every front.

sentences.zh: 降婁、玄枵以負東海，春神主于岱宗，歲星位焉。

translations.literal: Jianglou and Xuanxiao face the Eastern Sea; the spirit of spring governs at Mount Tai, and Jupiter holds its station there.
translations.idiomatic: Jianglou and Xuanxiao face the Eastern Sea; the spirit of spring holds sway at Mount Tai, and Jupiter takes its station there.

sentences.zh: 星紀、鶉尾以負南海，其神主於衡山，熒惑位焉。

translations.literal: Xingji and Chunwei face the Southern Sea; their spirit governs at Southern Mount Heng, and Mars holds its station there.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji and Chunwei face the Southern Sea; their spirit holds sway at Southern Mount Heng, and Mars takes its station there.

sentences.zh: 鶉首、實沈以負西海，其神主于華山，太白位焉。

translations.literal: Chunshou and Shenshen face the Western Sea; their spirit governs at Mount Hua, and Venus holds its station there.
translations.idiomatic: Chunshou and Shenshen face the Western Sea; their spirit holds sway at Mount Hua, and Venus takes its station there.

sentences.zh: 大樑、析木以負北海，其神主於恒山，辰星位焉。

translations.literal: Daliang and Ximu face the Northern Sea; their spirit governs at Northern Mount Heng, and Mercury holds its station there.
translations.idiomatic: Daliang and Ximu face the Northern Sea; their spirit holds sway at Northern Mount Heng, and Mercury takes its station there.

sentences.zh: 鶉火、大火、壽星、豕韋為中州，其神主於嵩丘，鎮星位焉。

translations.literal: Chunhuo, Great Fire, Longevity Star, and Shiwei are the central domain; their spirit governs at Mount Song, and Saturn holds its station there.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhuo, Great Fire, Longevity Star, and Shiwei constitute the central domain; their spirit holds sway at Mount Song, and Saturn takes its station there.

sentences.zh: 近代諸儒言星土者，或以州，或以國。

translations.literal: In recent times, when scholars speak of star-territory correspondences, some use prefectures and some use states.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times, scholars who discuss star-territory correspondences have sometimes mapped them to prefectures and sometimes to feudal states.

sentences.zh: 虞、夏、秦、漢，郡國廢置不同。

translations.literal: Under Yu, Xia, Qin, and Han, commanderies and states were abolished and established differently.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yu, Xia, Qin, and Han dynasties, commanderies and feudal states were abolished and re-established in different arrangements.

sentences.zh: 周之興也，王畿千里，及其衰也，僅得河南七縣。

translations.literal: When Zhou rose, its royal domain was a thousand li; when it declined, it retained only seven counties in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou rose to power, its royal domain spanned a thousand li; by the time it declined, it held no more than seven counties in Henan.

sentences.zh: 今又天下一統，而直以鶉火為周分，則疆場舛矣。

translations.literal: Now the realm is unified under one rule, yet to assign Chunhuo directly as Zhou's territorial allotment would make the boundaries wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the realm is unified under one rule, to assign Chunhuo directly as Zhou's territorial allotment would grossly misalign the boundaries.

sentences.zh: 七國之初，天下地形雌韓而雄魏，魏地西距高陵，盡河東、河內，北固漳、鄴，東分梁、宋，至於汝南，韓據全鄭之地，南盡潁川、南陽、西達虢略，距函穀，固宜陽，北連上地，皆綿亙數州，相錯如繡。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Seven Warring States, the terrain of the realm was feminine Han and masculine Wei: Wei's territory reached Gaoling in the west and encompassed Hedong and Henei; in the north it held Zhang and Ye; in the east it divided Liang and Song, reaching Runan; Han held all Zheng's lands, south to Yingchuan and Nanyang, west to Guolue, facing Hangu Pass, holding Yiyang, north connecting Shangdi — all stretching across several prefectures, interwoven like embroidery.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of the Warring States period, the realm's terrain favored Han in the south and Wei in the north: Wei reached Gaoling in the west and held Hedong and Henei; in the north it secured Zhang and Ye; in the east it divided Liang and Song down to Runan; Han held all of Zheng, south to Yingchuan and Nanyang, west to Guolue, facing Hangu Pass and holding Yiyang, northward connecting Shangdi — territories spanning several prefectures and interwoven like embroidery.

sentences.zh: 考雲漢山河之象，多者或至十餘宿。

translations.literal: Examining the image of the Cloud River and mountains and rivers, some regions correspond to more than ten lodges.
translations.idiomatic: When one examines the celestial image of the Cloud River against mountains and rivers, some regions correspond to more than ten lodges.

sentences.zh: 其後魏徙大樑，則西河合于東井；

translations.literal: Later, when Wei moved its capital to Daliang, the Western River merged with the Well;
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Wei moved its capital to Daliang, the Western River came under the Well;

sentences.zh: 秦拔宜陽，而上党入於輿鬼。

translations.literal: When Qin seized Yiyang, Shangdang entered the Chariot Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin seized Yiyang, Shangdang passed into the Chariot Ghost.

sentences.zh: 方戰國未滅時，星家之言，屢有明效。

translations.literal: While the Warring States had not yet been extinguished, the words of star specialists repeatedly had clear effect.
translations.idiomatic: While the Warring States still stood, the pronouncements of star specialists repeatedly proved strikingly accurate.

sentences.zh: 今則同在畿甸之中矣。

translations.literal: Now they all lie within the same capital district.
translations.idiomatic: Now they all lie within the same capital district.

sentences.zh: 而或者猶據《漢書地理志》推之，是守甘、石遺術，而不知變通之數也。

translations.literal: Yet some still deduce from the Han Geography Treatise — this is clinging to the legacy methods of Gan and Shi without knowing the principle of adaptation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet some still derive their allotments from the Han Geography Treatise — clinging to the legacy methods of Gan and Shi without grasping the principle of adaptation.

sentences.zh: 又古之辰次與節氣相系，各據當時歷數，與歲差遷徙不同。

translations.literal: Moreover, the ancient lodge-sequence positions were tied to the solar terms, each according to the calendar reckoning of its time, differing from the shifting caused by precession.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the ancient lodge-sequence positions were tied to the solar terms, each reckoned according to the calendar of its day — unlike the shifting caused by precession.

sentences.zh: 今更以七宿之中分四象中位，自上元之首，以度數紀之，而著其分野，其州縣雖改隸不同，但據山河以分爾。

translations.literal: Now we further take the middle positions of the four images from among the seven lodges, record them in degrees from the head of the upper origin, and set forth their territorial divisions; though prefectures and counties may change their administrative affiliation, the allotments are made solely according to mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: We now take the central positions of the four celestial quadrants from among the seven lodges, record them in degrees from the head of the upper origin, and set forth their territorial divisions; though prefectures and counties may change administrative affiliation, the allotments are determined solely by mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 須女、虛、危，玄枵也。

translations.literal: Maid, Emptiness, and Rooftop — these are Xuanxiao.
translations.idiomatic: Maid, Emptiness, and Rooftop constitute Xuanxiao.

sentences.zh: 初，須女五度，餘二千三百七十四，秒四少。

translations.literal: Beginning: five degrees of Maid, remainder 2374, seconds four slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: five degrees into Maid, with a remainder of 2374 and four-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，虛九度。

translations.literal: Middle: nine degrees of Emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: nine degrees into Emptiness.

sentences.zh: 終，危十二度。

translations.literal: End: twelve degrees of Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: twelve degrees into Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 其分野，自濟北東逾濟水，涉平陰，至於山莊，循岱嶽眾山之陰，東南及高密，又東盡萊夷之地，得漢北海、千乘、淄川，濟南、濟郡及平原、渤海、九河故道之南，濱于碣石。

translations.literal: Its territorial division: from Jibei eastward crossing the Ji River, passing Pingyin, reaching Shanzhaung, following the northern slopes of Mount Tai and its surrounding peaks, southeast to Gaomi, then east to the lands of the Lai barbarians, comprising Han Beihai, Qiancheng, Zichuan, Jinan, Jijun, and the south of the old courses of Pingyuan, Bohai, and the Nine Rivers, reaching the shore at Jieshi.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial division runs from Jibei eastward across the Ji River, through Pingyin to Shanzhaung, along the northern slopes of Mount Tai and its surrounding peaks, southeast to Gaomi, then east to the lands of the Lai barbarians — comprising Han Beihai, Qiancheng, Zichuan, Jinan, Jijun, and the country south of the old courses of Pingyuan, Bohai, and the Nine Rivers, reaching the shore at Jieshi.

sentences.zh: 古齊、紀、祝、淳於、萊、譚、寒及斟尋、有過、有鬲、蒲姑氏之國，其地得陬訾之下流，自濟東達於河外，故其象著為天津，絕雲漢之陽。

translations.literal: The ancient states of Qi, Ji, Zhu, Chunyu, Lai, Tan, Han, Zhenxun, Youguo, Youge, and the Pugu clan — their lands lay in the lower reaches of Zouzi, from east of Ji reaching beyond the river; hence their image appears as the Celestial Ford, crossing to the yang side of the Cloud River.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient states of Qi, Ji, Zhu, Chunyu, Lai, Tan, Han, Zhenxun, Youguo, Youge, and the Pugu clan occupied the lower reaches of Zouzi, from east of Ji to beyond the river; hence their celestial image appears as the Celestial Ford, standing on the southern side of the Cloud River.

sentences.zh: 凡司人之星與群臣之錄，皆主虛、危，故岱宗為十二諸侯受命府。

translations.literal: All stars governing the director of men and the register of ministers preside over Emptiness and Rooftop; hence Mount Tai is the receiving hall where the twelve feudal lords receive their mandates.
translations.idiomatic: The stars governing the director of men and the register of ministers all preside over Emptiness and Rooftop; hence Mount Tai is the hall where the twelve feudal lords receive their mandates.

sentences.zh: 又下流得婺女，當九河末派，比于星紀，與吳、越同占。

translations.literal: Further, in the lower reaches lies Maid, at the final branch of the Nine Rivers, comparable to Xingji, sharing the same omen with Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Further downstream lies Maid, at the final branch of the Nine Rivers — comparable to Xingji and sharing the same omen with Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 營室、東壁，陬訾也。

translations.literal: Encampment and Eastern Wall — these are Zouzi.
translations.idiomatic: Encampment and Eastern Wall constitute Zouzi.

sentences.zh: 初，危十三度，餘二千九百二十六，秒一太。

translations.literal: Beginning: thirteen degrees of Rooftop, remainder 2926, seconds one slightly more.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: thirteen degrees into Rooftop, with a remainder of 2926 and one-odd second.

sentences.zh: 中，營室十二度。

translations.literal: Middle: twelve degrees of Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: twelve degrees into Encampment.

sentences.zh: 終，奎一度。

translations.literal: End: one degree of Kui.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: one degree into Kui.

sentences.zh: 自王屋、太行而東，得漢河內，至北紀之東隅，北負漳、鄴，東及館陶、聊城。

translations.literal: From Wangwu and the Taihang eastward, comprising Han Henei, to the eastern corner of the Northern Thread, north facing Zhang and Ye, east to Guantao and Liaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: From Wangwu and the Taihang eastward through Han Henei to the eastern corner of the Northern Thread, north facing Zhang and Ye, east to Guantao and Liaocheng.

sentences.zh: 又自河、濟之交，涉滎波，濱濟水而東，得東郡之地，古邶、庸阝、衛、凡、胙、邗、雍、共、微、觀、南燕、昆吾、豕韋之國。

translations.literal: Further, from the confluence of the Yellow and Ji Rivers, crossing Yingbo, following the Ji River eastward, comprising the lands of Dongjun — the ancient states of Bei, Yong, Wei, Fan, Zuo, Han, Yong, Gong, Wei, Guan, Nanyan, Kunwu, and Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Further, from the confluence of the Yellow and Ji Rivers, crossing Yingbo and following the Ji River eastward, one reaches the lands of Dongjun — the ancient states of Bei, Yong, Wei, Fan, Zuo, Han, Yong, Gong, Wei, Guan, Nanyan, Kunwu, and Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 自閣道、王良至東壁，在豕韋，為上流。

translations.literal: From the Celestial Passage and Wangliang to Eastern Wall, in Shiwei, is the upper reach.
translations.idiomatic: From the Celestial Passage and Wangliang to Eastern Wall, within Shiwei, marks the upper reach.

sentences.zh: 當河內及漳、鄴之南，得山河之會，為離宮。

translations.literal: At the south of Henei and Zhang and Ye, where mountains and rivers meet, is the detached palace.
translations.idiomatic: Where Henei and the region south of Zhang and Ye meet at the confluence of mountains and rivers lies the detached palace.

sentences.zh: 又循河、濟而東接玄枵為營室之分。

translations.literal: Further, following the Yellow and Ji Rivers eastward to join Xuanxiao is the allotment of Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Further, following the Yellow and Ji Rivers eastward to join Xuanxiao constitutes the allotment of Encampment.

sentences.zh: 奎、數，降婁也。

translations.literal: Kui and Lou — these are Jianglou.
translations.idiomatic: Kui and Lou constitute Jianglou.

sentences.zh: 初，奎二度，餘千二百一十七，秒十七少。

translations.literal: Beginning: two degrees of Kui, remainder 1217, seconds seventeen slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: two degrees into Kui, with a remainder of 1217 and seventeen-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，婁一度。

translations.literal: Middle: one degree of Lou.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: one degree into Lou.

sentences.zh: 終，胃三度。

translations.literal: End: three degrees of Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: three degrees into Stomach.

sentences.zh: 自蛇丘、肥成，南屆钜野，東達梁父，循岱嶽眾山之陽，以負東海。

translations.literal: From Sheqiu and Feicheng, south to Juye, east to Liangfu, following the southern slopes of Mount Tai and its surrounding peaks, facing the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: From Sheqiu and Feicheng south to Juye and east to Liangfu, along the southern slopes of Mount Tai and its surrounding peaks, facing the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 又濱泗水，經方與、沛、留、彭城，東至於呂梁，乃東南抵淮，並淮水而東，盡徐夷之地，得漢東平、魯國、琅邪、東海、泗水、城陽，古魯、薛、邾、莒、小邾、徐、郯、鄫、鄅、邳、邿、任、宿、須句、顓臾、牟、遂、鑄夷、介、根牟及大庭氏之國。

translations.literal: Further, following the Si River, passing Fangyu, Pei, Liu, and Pengcheng, east to Lüliang, then southeast to the Huai, and along the Huai eastward through the lands of the Xu barbarians, comprising Han Dongping, Lu, Langye, Donghai, Sishui, and Chengyang — the ancient states of Lu, Xue, Zhu, Ju, Xiao Zhu, Xu, Tan, Zeng, Yu, Pi, Shi, Ren, Su, Xuju, Zhuanyu, Mou, Sui, Zhuyi, Jie, Genmou, and the Datin clan.
translations.idiomatic: Further, following the Si River through Fangyu, Pei, Liu, and Pengcheng east to Lüliang, then southeast to the Huai and along the Huai eastward through the lands of the Xu barbarians — comprising Han Dongping, Lu, Langye, Donghai, Sishui, and Chengyang, and the ancient states of Lu, Xue, Zhu, Ju, Xiao Zhu, Xu, Tan, Zeng, Yu, Pi, Shi, Ren, Su, Xuju, Zhuanyu, Mou, Sui, Zhuyi, Jie, Genmou, and the Datin clan.

sentences.zh: 奎為大澤，在陬訾下流，當钜野之東陽，至於淮、泗。

translations.literal: Kui is the Great Marsh, in the lower reaches of Zouzi, at the eastern yang of Juye, reaching the Huai and Si.
translations.idiomatic: Kui is the Great Marsh, in the lower reaches of Zouzi, at the eastern yang of Juye, reaching the Huai and Si.

sentences.zh: 婁、胃之墟，東北負山，蓋中國膏腴地，百穀之所阜也。

translations.literal: The domain of Lou and Stomach, northeast facing mountains, is the fertile heartland of the central domain, where the hundred grains flourish.
translations.idiomatic: The domain of Lou and Stomach, backed by mountains to the northeast, is the fertile heartland of the central domain, where the hundred grains flourish.

sentences.zh: 胃得馬牧之氣，與冀之北土同占。

translations.literal: Stomach receives the qi of horse pasture, sharing the same omen with the northern lands of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Stomach receives the qi of horse pasture and shares the same omen with the northern lands of Ji.

sentences.zh: 胃、昴、畢，大樑也。

translations.literal: Stomach, Hairy Head, and Net — these are Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: Stomach, Hairy Head, and Net constitute Daliang.

sentences.zh: 初，胃四度，餘二千五百四十九，秒八太。

translations.literal: Beginning: four degrees of Stomach, remainder 2549, seconds eight slightly more.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: four degrees into Stomach, with a remainder of 2549 and eight-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，昴六度。

translations.literal: Middle: six degrees of Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: six degrees into Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 終，畢九度。

translations.literal: End: nine degrees of Net.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: nine degrees into Net.

sentences.zh: 自魏郡濁漳之北，得漢趙國、廣平、钜鹿、常山，東及清河、信都，北據中山、真定，全趙之分。

translations.literal: From north of the Zhuo River in Wei Commandery, comprising Han Zhao, Guangping, Julu, and Changshan, east to Qinghe and Xindu, north holding Zhongshan and Zhending — the full allotment of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: From north of the Zhuo River in Wei Commandery through Han Zhao, Guangping, Julu, and Changshan, east to Qinghe and Xindu, north holding Zhongshan and Zhending — the full allotment of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 又北逾眾山，盡代郡、雁門、雲中、定襄之地與北方群狄之國。

translations.literal: Further north, crossing the mountain ranges, encompassing the lands of Dai, Yanmen, Yunzhong, and Dingxiang and the northern barbarian states.
translations.idiomatic: Further north, crossing the mountain ranges, one reaches the lands of Dai, Yanmen, Yunzhong, and Dingxiang and the barbarian states of the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 北紀之東陽，表裏山河，以蕃屏中國，為畢分。

translations.literal: The eastern yang of the Northern Thread, with mountains and rivers inside and out, screens the central domain — this is the allotment of Net.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern yang of the Northern Thread, with mountains and rivers forming inner and outer barriers, screens the central domain — this is the allotment of Net.

sentences.zh: 循北河之表，西盡塞垣，皆髦頭故地，為昴分。

translations.literal: Following the outer side of the Northern River, west to the frontier ramparts — all the former lands of Maotou — is the allotment of Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Following the outer side of the Northern River west to the frontier ramparts — all the former lands of Maotou — constitutes the allotment of Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 冀之北土，馬牧之所蕃庶，故天苑之象存焉。

translations.literal: The northern lands of Ji, where horse pasture flourishes, preserve the image of the Celestial Park.
translations.idiomatic: The northern lands of Ji, where horse pasture flourishes, preserve the image of the Celestial Park.

sentences.zh: 觜觿、參、伐，實沈也。

translations.literal: Beak, Three Stars, and Attack — these are Shenshen.
translations.idiomatic: Beak, Three Stars, and Attack constitute Shenshen.

sentences.zh: 初，畢十度，餘八百四十一，秒四之一。

translations.literal: Beginning: ten degrees of Net, remainder 841, seconds four minus one quarter.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: ten degrees into Net, with a remainder of 841 and four seconds minus one quarter.

sentences.zh: 中，參七度。

translations.literal: Middle: seven degrees of Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: seven degrees into Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 終，東井十一度。

translations.literal: End: eleven degrees of Well.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: eleven degrees into Well.

sentences.zh: 自漢之河東及上黨、太原，盡西河之地，古晉、魏、虞、唐、耿、楊、霍、冀、黎、郇與西河戎狄之國。

translations.literal: From Han Hedong and Shangdang and Taiyuan, encompassing the lands of the Western River — the ancient states of Jin, Wei, Yu, Tang, Geng, Yang, Huo, Ji, Li, Xun, and the Western River Rong and Di.
translations.idiomatic: From Han Hedong through Shangdang and Taiyuan to the lands of the Western River — the ancient states of Jin, Wei, Yu, Tang, Geng, Yang, Huo, Ji, Li, and Xun, together with the Rong and Di of the Western River.

sentences.zh: 西河之濱，所以設險限秦、晉，故其地上應天闕。

translations.literal: The banks of the Western River, where barriers were set to limit Qin and Jin, correspond on high to the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The banks of the Western River, where natural barriers were set to divide Qin and Jin, correspond on high to the Celestial Gate.

sentences.zh: 其南曲之陰，在晉地，眾山之陽；

translations.literal: The yin of its southern bend lies in Jin territory, on the yang side of the massed peaks;
translations.idiomatic: The yin of its southern bend lies in Jin territory, on the sunny side of the massed peaks;

sentences.zh: 南曲之陽，在秦地，眾山之陰。

translations.literal: The yang of its southern bend lies in Qin territory, on the yin side of the massed peaks.
translations.idiomatic: The yang of its southern bend lies in Qin territory, on the shaded side of the massed peaks.

sentences.zh: 陰陽之氣並，故與東井通。

translations.literal: Yin and yang qi converge, hence it connects with the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Yin and yang qi converge there, hence it connects with the Well.

sentences.zh: 河東永樂、芮城、河北縣及河曲豐、勝、夏州，皆東井之分。

translations.literal: Yongle, Ruicheng, and Hebei County in Hedong, and Feng, Sheng, and Xiazhou in the River Bend, all belong to the allotment of the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle, Ruicheng, and Hebei County in Hedong, together with Feng, Sheng, and Xiazhou in the River Bend, all fall within the allotment of the Well.

sentences.zh: 參、伐為戎索，為武政，當河東，盡大夏之墟。

translations.literal: Three Stars and Attack are the Rong cord, the governance of war; facing Hedong, they encompass the domain of Great Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Three Stars and Attack form the Rong cord and govern martial affairs; facing Hedong, they encompass the domain of Great Xia.

sentences.zh: 上党次居下流，與趙、魏接，為觜觿之分。

translations.literal: Shangdang next lies in the lower reach, bordering Zhao and Wei — the allotment of Beak.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdang next lies in the lower reach, bordering Zhao and Wei — the allotment of Beak.

sentences.zh: 東井、輿鬼，鶉首也。

translations.literal: Well and Chariot Ghost — these are Chunshou.
translations.idiomatic: Well and Chariot Ghost constitute Chunshou.

sentences.zh: 初，東井十二度，餘二千一百七十二，秒十五太。

translations.literal: Beginning: twelve degrees of Well, remainder 2172, seconds fifteen slightly more.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: twelve degrees into Well, with a remainder of 2172 and fifteen-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，東井二十七度。

translations.literal: Middle: twenty-seven degrees of Well.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: twenty-seven degrees into Well.

sentences.zh: 終，柳六度。

translations.literal: End: six degrees of Willow.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: six degrees into Willow.

sentences.zh: 自漢三輔及北地、上郡、安定，西自隴坻至河右，西南盡巴、蜀、漢中之地，及西南夷犍為、越雋、益州郡，極南河之表，東至牂柯，古秦、梁、豳、芮、豐、畢、駘杠、有扈、密須、庸、蜀、羌、髳之國。

translations.literal: From Han's Three Adjuncts and Beidi, Shangjun, and Anding, west from Longqi to the right bank of the Yellow River, southwest through Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong, and the southwestern Yi of Jianwei, Yuexi, and Yizhou Commandery, to the far south beyond the Southern River, east to Zangke — the ancient states of Qin, Liang, Bin, Rui, Feng, Bi, Taigang, Youhu, Mixu, Yong, Shu, Qiang, and Mao.
translations.idiomatic: From Han's Three Adjuncts through Beidi, Shangjun, and Anding, west from Longqi to the right bank of the Yellow River, southwest through Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong, and the southwestern Yi of Jianwei, Yuexi, and Yizhou Commandery, to the far south beyond the Southern River and east to Zangke — the ancient states of Qin, Liang, Bin, Rui, Feng, Bi, Taigang, Youhu, Mixu, Yong, Shu, Qiang, and Mao.

sentences.zh: 東井居兩河之陰，自山河上流，當地絡之西北。

translations.literal: The Well lies on the yin side of the Two Rivers, from the upper reaches of mountains and rivers, corresponding to the northwest of the terrestrial thread.
translations.idiomatic: The Well lies on the northern side of the Two Rivers, at the upper reaches of mountains and rivers, corresponding to the northwest of the terrestrial thread.

sentences.zh: 輿鬼居兩河之陽，自漢中東盡華陽，與鶉火相接，當地絡之東南。

translations.literal: The Chariot Ghost lies on the yang side of the Two Rivers, from Hanzhong east to Huayang, connecting with Chunhuo, corresponding to the southeast of the terrestrial thread.
translations.idiomatic: The Chariot Ghost lies on the southern side of the Two Rivers, from Hanzhong east to Huayang, connecting with Chunhuo and corresponding to the southeast of the terrestrial thread.

sentences.zh: 鶉首之外，雲漢潛流而未達，故狼星在江、河上源之西，弧矢、犬、雞皆徼外之備也。

translations.literal: Beyond Chunshou, the Cloud River flows hidden and has not yet reached its terminus; hence the Wolf Star lies west of the upper sources of the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers, and Bow and Arrow, Dog, and Cock are all frontier defenses beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Chunshou, the Cloud River flows hidden and has not yet reached its terminus; hence the Wolf Star lies west of the upper sources of the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers, while Bow and Arrow, Dog, and Cock all serve as frontier defenses beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 西羌、吐蕃、吐谷渾及西南徼外夷人，皆占狼星。

translations.literal: The Western Qiang, Tubo, Tuyuhun, and the southwestern barbarians beyond the frontier all take their omen from the Wolf Star.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Qiang, Tubo, Tuyuhun, and the southwestern barbarians beyond the frontier all take their omen from the Wolf Star.

sentences.zh: 柳、七星、張，鶉火也。

translations.literal: Willow, Seven Stars, and Extended Net — these are Chunhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Willow, Seven Stars, and Extended Net constitute Chunhuo.

sentences.zh: 初，柳七度，餘四百六十四，秒七少。

translations.literal: Beginning: seven degrees of Willow, remainder 464, seconds seven slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: seven degrees into Willow, with a remainder of 464 and seven-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，七星七度。

translations.literal: Middle: seven degrees of Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: seven degrees into Seven Stars.

sentences.zh: 終，張十四度。

translations.literal: End: fourteen degrees of Extended Net.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: fourteen degrees into Extended Net.

sentences.zh: 北自滎澤、滎陽，並京、索，暨山南，得新鄭、密縣，至外方東隅，斜至方城，抵桐柏，北自宛、葉，南暨漢東，盡漢南陽之地。

translations.literal: North from Xingze and Xingyang, along Jing and Suo, reaching the south of the mountains, comprising Xinzheng and Mi County, to the eastern corner of Waifang, slanting to Fangcheng, reaching Tongbai, north from Wan and Ye, south to the east of Han, encompassing all of Han Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: North from Xingze and Xingyang, along Jing and Suo to the south of the mountains, through Xinzheng and Mi County to the eastern corner of Waifang, slanting to Fangcheng and Tongbai, north from Wan and Ye and south to the east of Han — encompassing all of Han Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 又自雒邑負北河之南，西及函谷，逾南紀，達武當、漢水之陰，盡弘農郡，以淮源、桐柏、東陽為限，而申州屬壽星，古成周、虢、鄭、管、鄶、東虢、密、滑、焦、唐、隨、申、鄧及祝融氏之都。

translations.literal: Further, from Luoyi facing the south of the Northern River, west to Hangu Pass, crossing the Southern Thread, reaching the yin side of Wudang and the Han River, encompassing Hongnong Commandery, bounded by Huaiyuan, Tongbai, and Dongyang — while Shenzhou belongs to Longevity Star — the ancient Chengzhou, Guo, Zheng, Guan, Kuai, Eastern Guo, Mi, Hua, Jiao, Tang, Sui, Shen, Deng, and the capital of the Zhurong clan.
translations.idiomatic: Further, from Luoyi facing the south of the Northern River, west to Hangu Pass, crossing the Southern Thread to the yin side of Wudang and the Han River, encompassing Hongnong Commandery and bounded by Huaiyuan, Tongbai, and Dongyang — while Shenzhou belongs to Longevity Star — lie the ancient Chengzhou, Guo, Zheng, Guan, Kuai, Eastern Guo, Mi, Hua, Jiao, Tang, Sui, Shen, Deng, and the capital of the Zhurong clan.

sentences.zh: 新鄭為軒轅、祝融之墟，其東鄙則入壽星。

translations.literal: Xinzheng is the domain of Xuanyuan and Zhurong; its eastern border enters Longevity Star.
translations.idiomatic: Xinzheng is the domain of Xuanyuan and Zhurong; its eastern border falls within Longevity Star.

sentences.zh: 柳。

translations.literal: Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Willow.

sentences.zh: 在輿鬼東，又接漢源，當益、洛之陽，接南河上流。

translations.literal: East of the Chariot Ghost, also connecting with the Han source, facing the yang of Yi and Luo, joining the upper reach of the Southern River.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Chariot Ghost, connecting with the Han source, facing the sunny side of Yi and Luo and joining the upper reach of the Southern River.

sentences.zh: 七星系軒轅，得土行正位，中嶽象也，河南之分。

translations.literal: Seven Stars is tied to Xuanyuan, obtaining the orthodox position of the Earth phase; it is the image of the Central Peak — the allotment of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Stars is tied to Xuanyuan and holds the orthodox position of the Earth phase; it is the image of the Central Peak — the allotment of Henan.

sentences.zh: 張，直南陽，漢東，與鶉尾同占。

translations.literal: Extended Net faces Nanyang and the east of Han, sharing the same omen with Chunwei.
translations.idiomatic: Extended Net faces Nanyang and the east of Han, sharing the same omen with Chunwei.

sentences.zh: 翼、軫，鶉尾也。

translations.literal: Wings and Chariot Crossboard — these are Chunwei.
translations.idiomatic: Wings and Chariot Crossboard constitute Chunwei.

sentences.zh: 初，張十五度，餘千七百九十五，秒二十二太。

translations.literal: Beginning: fifteen degrees of Extended Net, remainder 1795, seconds twenty-two slightly more.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: fifteen degrees into Extended Net, with a remainder of 1795 and twenty-two-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，翼十二度。

translations.literal: Middle: twelve degrees of Wings.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: twelve degrees into Wings.

sentences.zh: 終，軫九度。

translations.literal: End: nine degrees of Chariot Crossboard.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: nine degrees into Chariot Crossboard.

sentences.zh: 自房陵、白帝而東，盡漢之南郡、江夏，東達廬江南部，濱彭蠡之西，得長沙、武陵，又逾南紀，盡郁林、合浦之地，自沅、湘上流，西達黔安之左，皆全楚之分。

translations.literal: From Fangling and Baidi eastward, encompassing Han Nanjun and Jiangxia, east to the southern part of Lujiang, along the west of Poyang, comprising Changsha and Wuling, further crossing the Southern Thread to the lands of Yulin and Hepu, from the upper reaches of Yuan and Xiang west to the left of Qian'an — all the full allotment of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: From Fangling and Baidi eastward through Han Nanjun and Jiangxia to the southern part of Lujiang, along the west of Poyang, comprising Changsha and Wuling, further crossing the Southern Thread to the lands of Yulin and Hepu, from the upper reaches of Yuan and Xiang west to the left of Qian'an — the full allotment of Chu.

sentences.zh: 自富、昭、象、龔、繡、容、白、廉州已西，亦鶉尾之墟。

translations.literal: From Fu, Zhao, Xiang, Gong, Xiu, Rong, Bai, and Lian prefectures westward is also the domain of Chunwei.
translations.idiomatic: From Fu, Zhao, Xiang, Gong, Xiu, Rong, Bai, and Lian prefectures westward also lies the domain of Chunwei.

sentences.zh: 古荊楚、鄖、鄀、羅、權、巴、夔與南方蠻貊之國。

translations.literal: The ancient Jing-Chu, Yun, Ruo, Luo, Quan, Ba, Kui, and the southern barbarian and Mo states.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient Jing-Chu, Yun, Ruo, Luo, Quan, Ba, and Kui, together with the southern barbarian and Mo states.

sentences.zh: 翼與咮張同象，當南河之北，軫在天關之外，當南河之南，其中一星主長沙，逾嶺徼而南，為東甌、青丘之分。

translations.literal: Wings shares the same omen with Beak and Extended Net, facing the north of the Southern River; Chariot Crossboard lies beyond the Celestial Pass, facing the south of the Southern River; one star among them governs Changsha, and south beyond the mountain frontier is the allotment of Dong'ou and Qingqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Wings shares the same omen with Beak and Extended Net, facing the north of the Southern River; Chariot Crossboard lies beyond the Celestial Pass, facing the south of the Southern River; one star among them governs Changsha, and south beyond the mountain frontier lies the allotment of Dong'ou and Qingqiu.

sentences.zh: 安南諸州在雲漢上源之東陽，宜屬鶉火。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Annan lie in the eastern yang of the upper source of the Cloud River and ought to belong to Chunhuo.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Annan lie in the eastern yang of the upper source of the Cloud River and ought to belong to Chunhuo.

sentences.zh: 而柳、七星、張皆當中州，不得連負海之地，故麗於鶉尾。

translations.literal: Yet Willow, Seven Stars, and Extended Net all face the central domain and cannot connect to sea-facing lands; hence they are attached to Chunwei.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Willow, Seven Stars, and Extended Net all face the central domain and cannot connect to sea-facing lands; hence they are attached to Chunwei.

sentences.zh: 角、亢，壽星也。

translations.literal: Horn and Gullet — these are Longevity Star.
translations.idiomatic: Horn and Gullet constitute Longevity Star.

sentences.zh: 初，軫十度，餘八十七，秒十四少。

translations.literal: Beginning: ten degrees of Chariot Crossboard, remainder 87, seconds fourteen slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: ten degrees into Chariot Crossboard, with a remainder of 87 and fourteen-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，角八度。

translations.literal: Middle: eight degrees of Horn.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: eight degrees into Horn.

sentences.zh: 終，氐一度。

translations.literal: At the end: one degree into Root.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: one degree into Root.

sentences.zh: 自原武、管城，濱河、濟之南，東至封丘、陳留，盡陳、蔡、汝南之地，逾淮源，至於弋陽，西涉南陽郡至於桐柏，又東北抵嵩之東陽，中國地絡在南北河之間，首自西傾，極於陪尾，故隨、申，光皆豫州之分，宜屬鶉火，古陳、蔡、許、息、江、黃、道、柏、沈、賴、蓼、須頓、胡、防、弦、厲之國。

translations.literal: From Yuanwu and Guancheng, along the south of the Yellow River and Ji, east to Fengqiu and Chenliu, through the lands of Chen, Cai, and Runan, crossing the Huai's source to Yiyang, west into Nanyang commandery to Tongbai, then northeast to the eastern yang of Song — the terrestrial network of China lies between the Northern and Southern Rivers, beginning at Western Slope and ending at Companion Tail; hence Sui, Shen, and Guang all belong to Yuzhou's allotment and should fall under Vermillion Fire, the ancient states of Chen, Cai, Xu, Xi, Jiang, Huang, Dao, Bai, Shen, Lai, Liao, Xudun, Hu, Fang, Xian, and Li.
translations.idiomatic: From Yuanwu and Guancheng along the south bank of the Yellow River and Ji, east to Fengqiu and Chenliu, through Chen, Cai, and Runan, past the Huai's source to Yiyang, west into Nanyang as far as Tongbai, then northeast to the eastern flank of Mount Song — China's terrestrial network runs between the Northern and Southern Rivers, from Western Slope to Companion Tail. Sui, Shen, and Guang all belong to Yuzhou and should be assigned to Vermillion Fire: the ancient lands of Chen, Cai, Xu, Xi, Jiang, Huang, Dao, Bai, Shen, Lai, Liao, Xudun, Hu, Fang, Xian, and Li.

sentences.zh: 氐涉壽星，當洛邑眾山之東，與亳土相接，次南直潁水之間，曰太昊之墟，為亢分。

translations.literal: Root crosses Longevity Star, standing east of the mountains around Luoyang, adjoining Bo territory; next south, straight between the Ying waters — called the ruins of Taihao — is the allotment of Gullet.
translations.idiomatic: Root overlaps Longevity Star, east of the Luoyang mountains and adjoining Bo territory; farther south, along the Ying River, lies Taihao's domain — the allotment of Gullet.

sentences.zh: 又南涉淮氣連鶉尾，在成周之東陽，為角分。

translations.literal: Farther south it crosses the Huai's qi, connecting with Vermillion Tail, at the eastern yang of Chengzhou — the allotment of Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Still farther south it crosses the Huai's influence, linking with Vermillion Tail at the eastern flank of Chengzhou — the allotment of Horn.

sentences.zh: 氐、房、心，大火也。

translations.literal: Root, Chamber, and Heart — Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Root, Chamber, and Heart constitute Great Fire.

sentences.zh: 初，氐二度，餘千四百一十九，秒五太。

translations.literal: At the beginning: two degrees into Root, remainder 1419, seconds five slightly more.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: two degrees into Root, with a remainder of 1419 and five-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，房二度。

translations.literal: At the middle: two degrees into Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: two degrees into Chamber.

sentences.zh: 終，尾六度。

translations.literal: At the end: six degrees into Tail.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: six degrees into Tail.

sentences.zh: 自雍丘、襄邑、小黃而東，循濟陰，界于齊、魯，右泗水，達于呂梁，乃東南接太昊之墟，盡漢濟陰、山陽、楚國、豐、沛之地，古宋、曹、郕、滕、茅、郜、蕭、葛、向城、逼陽、申父之國。

translations.literal: From Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and Xiaohuang eastward, following Jiyin, bordering Qi and Lu, with the Si River to the right, reaching Liang, then southeast connecting with Taihao's ruins, through Han Jiyin, Shanyang, the Chu kingdom, Feng, and Pei — the ancient states of Song, Cao, Cheng, Teng, Mao, Gao, Xiao, Ge, Xiangcheng, Biyang, and Shenfu.
translations.idiomatic: From Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and Xiaohuang east along Jiyin, between Qi and Lu, with the Si to the right as far as Liang, then southeast to Taihao's domain through Han Jiyin, Shanyang, the Chu kingdom, Feng, and Pei — ancient Song, Cao, Cheng, Teng, Mao, Gao, Xiao, Ge, Xiangcheng, Biyang, and Shenfu.

sentences.zh: 商、亳負北河，陽氣之所升也，為心分、豐、沛負南河，陽氣之所布也，為房分。

translations.literal: Shang and Bo face the Northern River where yang qi ascends — the allotment of Heart; Feng and Pei face the Southern River where yang qi spreads — the allotment of Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Shang and Bo lie along the Northern River where yang qi rises — Heart's allotment; Feng and Pei along the Southern River where yang qi spreads — Chamber's allotment.
