sentences.zh: 其下流與尾同占，西接陳、鄭為氐分。

translations.literal: Its lower reaches share omens with Tail; west it adjoins Chen and Zheng — the allotment of Root.
translations.idiomatic: Its lower course shares omens with Tail; to the west it borders Chen and Zheng — Root's allotment.

sentences.zh: 尾、箕，析木津也。

translations.literal: Tail and Winnowing Basket — the Ford of Split Wood.
translations.idiomatic: Tail and Winnowing Basket form the Ford of Split Wood.

sentences.zh: 初，尾七度，餘二千七百五十，秒二十一少，中，箕五度，終，南斗八度。

translations.literal: At the beginning: seven degrees into Tail, remainder 2750, seconds twenty-one slightly less; at the middle: five degrees into Winnowing Basket; at the end: eight degrees into Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: seven degrees into Tail, remainder 2750 and twenty-one-odd seconds; at the middle: five degrees into Winnowing Basket; at the end: eight degrees into Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 自渤海、九河之北，得漢河間、涿郡、廣陽及上谷、漁陽、右北平、遼西、遼東、樂浪、玄菟，古北燕、孤竹、無終、九夷之國。

translations.literal: North of Bohai and the Nine Rivers, comprising Han Hejian, Zhuo, Guangyang, Shanggu, Yuyang, Youbeiping, Liaoxi, Liaodong, Lelang, and Xuantu — the ancient states of Northern Yan, Guzhu, Wuzhong, and the Nine Yi.
translations.idiomatic: North of Bohai and the Nine Rivers lie Han Hejian, Zhuo, Guangyang, Shanggu, Yuyang, Youbeiping, Liaoxi, Liaodong, Lelang, and Xuantu — the lands of ancient Northern Yan, Guzhu, Wuzhong, and the Nine Yi.

sentences.zh: 尾得雲漢之末派，龜、魚麗焉，當九河之下流，濱於渤碣，皆北紀之所窮也。

translations.literal: Tail receives the Cloud River's final branch, where turtles and fish teem; it stands at the lower reaches of the Nine Rivers, along Bohai and Jieshi — all the limit of the Northern Thread.
translations.idiomatic: Tail marks the Cloud River's last branch, rich in turtles and fish, at the lower Nine Rivers along Bohai and Jieshi — the farthest reach of the Northern Thread.

sentences.zh: 箕與南斗相近，為遼水之陽，盡朝鮮三韓之地，在吳、越東。

translations.literal: Winnowing Basket is close to Southern Dipper, on the yang side of the Liao River, through the lands of Korea and the Three Han, east of Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Winnowing Basket lies near Southern Dipper, on the north bank of the Liao, through Korea and the Three Han, east of Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 南斗、牽牛，星紀也。

translations.literal: Southern Dipper and Lead Ox — Star Chronicle.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Dipper and Lead Ox form Star Chronicle.

sentences.zh: 初，南斗九度，餘千四十二，秒十二太。

translations.literal: At the beginning: nine degrees into Southern Dipper, remainder 1042, seconds twelve slightly more.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning: nine degrees into Southern Dipper, remainder 1042 and twelve-odd seconds.

sentences.zh: 中，南斗二十四度。

translations.literal: At the middle: twenty-four degrees into Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: At the middle: twenty-four degrees into Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 終，女四度。

translations.literal: At the end: four degrees into Maid.
translations.idiomatic: At the end: four degrees into Maid.

sentences.zh: 自廬江、九江，負淮水，南盡臨淮、廣陵，至於東海，又逾南河，得漢丹楊、會稽、豫章，西濱彭蠡，南涉越門，迄蒼梧、南海，逾嶺表，自韶、廣以西，珠崖以東，為星紀之分也。

translations.literal: From Lujiang and Jiujiang, along the Huai, south through Linhuai and Guangling to the Eastern Sea, then crossing the Southern River through Han Danyang, Kuaiji, and Yuzhang, west along Poyang, south through Yuemen to Cangwu and Nanhai, beyond the ranges — from Shao and Guang west to Zhuya east — the allotment of Star Chronicle.
translations.idiomatic: From Lujiang and Jiujiang along the Huai, south through Linhuai and Guangling to the Eastern Sea, then across the Southern River through Danyang, Kuaiji, and Yuzhang, west along Poyang, south through Yuemen to Cangwu and Nanhai, beyond the mountain ranges — from Shao and Guang west to Zhuya east — all belong to Star Chronicle.

sentences.zh: 古吳、越、群舒、廬、桐、六、蓼及東南百越之國。

translations.literal: The ancient states of Wu, Yue, the various Shu, Lu, Tong, Liu, Liao, and the Hundred Yue of the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient Wu, Yue, the Shu states, Lu, Tong, Liu, Liao, and the Hundred Yue of the southeast.

sentences.zh: 南斗在雲漢下流，當淮、海間，為吳分。

translations.literal: Southern Dipper lies in the Cloud River's lower course, between the Huai and the sea — Wu's allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Dipper stands in the Cloud River's lower reach between the Huai and the sea — Wu's allotment.

sentences.zh: 牽牛去南河浸遠，自豫章迄會稽，南逾嶺徼，為越分。

translations.literal: Lead Ox grows distant from the Southern River; from Yuzhang to Kuaiji, south beyond the frontier ranges — Yue's allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Lead Ox lies far from the Southern River; from Yuzhang to Kuaiji, south beyond the frontier passes — Yue's allotment.

sentences.zh: 島夷蠻貊之人，聲教所不暨，皆系于狗國云。

translations.literal: The island barbarians and Man and Mo peoples, where civilizing influence does not reach, are all assigned to the Dog Kingdom — so it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Island peoples and the Man and Mo tribes beyond the reach of civilization are all assigned to the Dog Kingdom — or so the tradition runs.
